profile.headline: Software Engineer | 9+ years at Cisco | Open to new opportunities | Backend Development · Distributed Systems · Java / Python · Network Security · Test Automation & CI/CD
profile.summary: Senior Software Engineer (Cisco, 9+ yrs) building backend systems in Java and Spring, with an M.S. in Computer Science and Machine Learning from Georgia Tech. I turn AI and agentic tooling into real engineering leverage — built a Hugging Face–based defect-triage system to speed up issue routing, and created agentic Codex skills that streamline debugging and automation for my team. I've led as Scrum Master for a 6+ engineer team while staying technical, and mentor engineers through code review. Open to engineering management roles where I can scale that impact, or senior/staff engineering roles where AI-driven productivity work is valued.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer, Test Infrastructure - Secure Firewall
positions.description:
• Designed and built an internal NLP-based bug triage tool using Hugging Face models to recommend correct defect fields from unstructured text, improving routing accuracy and reducing manual triage.
• Built and maintained automated test infrastructure for Cisco Secure Firewall, validating network flow analytics, correlation, and eventing.
• Created custom Codex skills used agentically to accelerate engineering workflows across debugging, manual test execution, and automation code authoring.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer - Secure Network Analytics
positions.description:
Supported the Secure Network Analytics (SNA) product line, contributing to both vulnerability management and feature development. Worked closely with cross-functional teams to ensure Cisco’s analytics products met the highest security and reliability standards.

Key Contributions:

• Identified and remediated vulnerabilities in third-party and open-source components.
• Contributed to backend improvements and automation for risk assessment and tracking.
• Helped streamline security workflows through tooling and process enhancements.
• Partnered with other teams to maintain compliance and consistent secure coding practices.

positions.title: Software Engineer III - Secure Network Analytics
positions.description:
Focused on product security and ongoing feature support for Cisco’s Network Analytics software. Worked to ensure the reliability and integrity of large-scale network monitoring systems.

Key Contributions:

• Conducted security assessments of third-party and open-source software components.
• Collaborated on the design and deployment of security patches and software updates.
• Participated in the vulnerability lifecycle — from assessment to remediation.
• Contributed to new feature development that improved network visibility and detection.
positions.insights: IPv6, Software Development Security and +11 skills

positions.title: Java Developer
positions.locationName: Johns Creek, Georgia, United States · On-site
positions.description:
As a junior Java developer at Macy's working on warehouse logistic software, I was responsible for developing and maintaining software applications that help manage the company's warehouse operations. I worked as part of a team, collaborating with other developers, project managers, and business stakeholders to design, develop, and test software solutions.

Some of the tasks that I was responsible for at Macy's included:

• Writing and debugging Java code
• Creating and maintaining database schemas
• Developing and implementing software features based on business requirements
• Writing and executing unit tests
• Participating in code reviews to ensure code quality and adherence to coding standards
• Collaborating with other team members to identify and resolve issues and improve the overall quality of the software
• Documenting code and software features
positions.insights: Spring Framework, Spring MVC and +3 skills

projects.title: IoT Smart Alarm
projects.description: The Smart Alarm is a fully integrated alarm clock that will wake you up in the morning with your favorite music or a default beeping tone, display the current weather, and turn on your room lights. The smart alarm can be set from the users smartphone by accessing the mbed server over the internet.
